'''Roast nuna''' was a type of food made from [[Nuna/Legends|Nuna]] meat.

==History==
The [[Nuna drumstick/Legends|drumsticks]] were a favorite of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]].

A Roast nuna was eaten in by [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Cut Lawquane/Legends|Cut]], [[Suu Lawquane/Legends|Suu]], [[Shaeeah Lawquane/Legends|Shaeeah]], and [[Jek Lawquane/Legends|Jek Lawquane]] at the [[Lawquane farmstead|Lawquane's farm]] on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].
